## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `35d2eaeb16a216f205756fb58c2e4df9cde386ec`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, docs/NORTH-STAR.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

### ① Derived judgments

Read from card #32997 (body and all four comments: audit 6846766675, claim 6849116174, amendment 6849221818, os-dev report 6849705523), PR #33080 (body, file list, net diff against `main`: 3 files, +27 −7) and this head's check-runs. The tree was judged, not the PR body's account of it; the dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not read. Result: one must-fix, one should-fix, six nits.

`filing-gate.md` 〈定级判据〉

1. p2 row: 「挡 p1 的流程或工具卡(靠 `pm:blocking` 排先,不升级)」 becomes 「挡他卡的流程或工具卡(`pm:blocking`,不沿链继承)」. **Right.** It is north-star change 2 in the execution note. The widening from "blocks a p1" to "blocks other cards" is the ruling's own "blocks other work".
2. p3 row loses 「真实用户可撞 ⇒ p2」. **Wrong.** That clause was the only statement of where the real-user raise lands, and no line of the card orders it out. See ④ F1.
3. Rule 1: fixed order, at most one raise with rules 7 and 8 exclusive, release-window p0 last, and the one-line 「谁 · 哪门 · 多频 · 实测或读码」. **Right.**
4. Rule 2: one step down on the card's triggers, floor p3, three no-discount cases, no second step for "no current user". Deletion of 「可达面定上界」. **Right.** The deleted line's 「`security` 标签不抬级」 half is carried by rule 4's 「否则按普通缺陷」.
5. Rule 3: no evidence cap. **Right as a transcription.** It meets the filing gate's `reach:` rule at one case the text does not decide. See ④ F2.
6. Rules 4, 5, 6: the security-boundary sentence; core task = a road row whose item is P0/P1; workaround = same role, same door, no data-model change, named by the error or the docs. **Right.**
7. Rule 7: default configuration, shipped docs or skill, wrong or stuck; a loud refusal with its remedy excluded. **Right as a test.** Its effect is gone (F1).
8. Rule 8: focus raise only for a wrong answer, a false green, or stuck with no remedy; never p0; four no-raise kinds sort first in their row. Deletion of 「重点功能…上调一档;纯散文跟进不升」. **Right.** The focus list stays in `lanes/triage.md` by pointer.
9. Rule 9: assertion defects at p2 with no item-grade inheritance; `pm:blocking` when one holds an acceptance verdict in the window; inheritance for real product breaks only; the maintainer's sentence. **Right.**

`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈Priority〉

10. Rule 2 gains "data silently wrong or lost ⇒ P1, subject to the grading rules' reach discount; any other run that goes wrong ⇒ P2". **Right.** The card writes "rule 2's discount"; the diff rightly does not copy that number, because on this page "rule 2" would read as the north star's own.
11. Rule 2 gains the one re-grade exception. **Right**, word for word.
12. Rule 3's inheritance clause becomes P2 plus `pm:blocking`, no inheritance up the chain. **Right**, word for word.
13. Nothing else on the page moves (two lines). **Right**: the card scopes the edit to 〈Priority〉.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`

14. The `filing-gate.md` CEILINGS row moves 67 → 79 under an eight-line comment. **Right.** See ④.

Outside the diff

15. `lanes/triage.md` is unchanged. **Right.** Its line 15 is a pointer to `filing-gate.md` plus the focus list rule 8 points at; restating any of the nine there would break "stated once".
16. Public surface: none. No published schema, no package path, no door.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` matches. The three paths are `.claude/**`, a repo-root `docs/` page and `scripts/pm/**`; none is in any package's shipped files, so nothing publishes. `Clause-②: no` holds, line-leading in the claim and in the PR body: no published accept set or export widens. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds. No `!` in the title.

Gate verdicts, the check-runs on this head read 2026-11-13T10:17Z: 51 runs, all completed, 28 success, 23 skipped, none failed, none pending. Among the successes: `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path)`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Test Core` with its three planned shards. The PR is a draft with auto-merge not armed, so this FAIL owes no disarm.

### ③ Boundary flags

The PR's author is the fleet relay, so there is no off-relay login to name.

Dev flags (os-dev report 6849705523)

- "The order's check-agents-md gate does not exist." **Answered.** No script, workflow step or package script of that name is in the tree at this head, and `AGENTS.md` is not in the file list. Nothing is owed.
- "check:doc-formula-expressions first exit 3." **Answered.** A missing local prerequisite, not a verdict. Every lint check-run on this head concluded success.
- "CI not yet read." **Answered** in ②: fully concluded.
- "No ablation." **Answered.** Rule text and one constant; no tested behaviour changed.
- The ruled raise, seat option A (amendment 6849221818). **Answered** in ④.

`open_questions`

- **(a) `lanes/triage.md` 「有公开卡只定 `security`+p1,余不判」 beside rule 4. Answered: leave it** (the dev's A), on a firmer ground than the one given. That line is the disclosure hold for a finding published by mistake (`security-findings.md` section 7): triage sets the label and p1, judges nothing, and the security seat owns the card from there. Rule 4's test is a sentence that names the step, which is the mechanism section 2 forbids on a public card. So the two never meet on one card: rule 4 governs ordinary cards that claim the p1 row's 「安全边界」, and the fixed p1 is assigned without judging. The same pairing stood on `main` (「`security` 标签不抬级」 beside the fixed p1). Not escalated.
- **(b) North-star rule 3's hold against a p2 `pm:blocking` tooling card. Escalated to the maintainer** (the dev's B). The effect is real. On `main` an instrument card that unblocks a product P0/P1 inherited that grade, so "dispatches no p2/p3 tooling card" did not reach it. At this head it is P2, so the hold reaches it whenever its lane still has an undispatched P0/P1 (`execution-duties.md` reads "open" as undispatched), while the selection order puts `pm:blocking` above p1. The grade is not in doubt, P2 either way; the dispatch order is. This follows from the ruling as worded and the diff transcribes it faithfully, so the diff must not answer it. Carrier: a maintainer question that links back to #32997, which is the runbook's rule for a question born while executing a ruling. ⛔ Not a re-hang of this card, ⛔ not a seat-proposed rule card.
- **(c) Out-of-scope finding: "The one measure: the road" still says a step "that runs through but gives a wrong result is P2". Escalated to the maintainer, one line in the Tier H approval request; not fixed here.** The card scopes the edit to 〈Priority〉 and the page is his, so a fourth sentence needs his word. It changes no grade a seat reaches today: grading reads 〈Priority〉 (`triage-duties.md`, and the section header of `filing-gate.md`), and Priority rule 1 already takes data integrity off the road.

Acceptance sweep, run over the references, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and the north star

- "Grades every protocol addition p1": **clean.** The p1 row keeps 「发版所需的协议增项」 and the p2 row 「普通协议增项」; no lane file, `AGENTS.md` or north-star sentence grades them all p1. The old order survives only in a historical raise comment in the ratchet script (58 → 61), which is the provenance of a landed ceiling and not a rule.
- "Discounts for no current user": **clean.** One hit, rule 2's own prohibition. The north star's Stage posture ("Few people use it … compatibility layers … default to p3") is a default for a kind of work, not a discount on a defect.
- "Caps code-read findings": **not clean on a plain reading**, and the PR body reports "the only hit was the retired line". See ④ F2.

Raised by this review

- Rule 9 and the p2 row say a card "carries" `pm:blocking`. `SKILL.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` define that label as a cache derived from the `Blocked-by:` index, ⛔ never hand-attached, and stripped by the triage sweep when no dependent names the card. For a blocking tooling card the dependents' `Blocked-by:` lines produce it. For rule 9's case nothing says which card carries the `Blocked-by:` line, and without one the sweep removes the label. The ruling's wording is transcribed faithfully, so this is not a finding on the diff. **Forwarded to triage** as a pointer on the card.

### ④ Design judgment

#### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md`

Rules 1 to 6, 8 and 9 are each stated once and faithfully: no softening, no addition, no p1 budget, no p3 auto-close. The maintainer's sentence 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」 is present under rule 9, character for character with the card. Every edited line is within the 120-byte cap (longest 120).

No replaced #32906 wording survives to contradict: the two superseded lines are gone, and the p0 row, the p1 row and the protocol-addition definition stand and agree with the nine. What does not survive, and should, is F1's clause.

**F1 — must-fix. The "real user can hit" raise has lost its landing grade.**
On `main` the p3 row ends 「真实用户可撞 ⇒ p2」: the raise lifts a default-p3 card to p2 and does nothing else. The diff deletes the clause, rule 7 carries the test alone, and rule 1 lists rule 7 as one of the two raises with no row attached. The card's rule 7 is the test only, its rule 1 only forbids taking both raises, and it replaces the earlier wording only "where they overlap"; nothing orders the "⇒ p2" out. Followed as written, a seat on first touch reaches grades that neither `main` nor the ruling gives:

- A user-visible defect with a workaround, on the default configuration: impact row p2, no discount, rule 7 holds (a wrong result following the shipped docs), so p1. `main` gives p2. The north star at this same head says "any other run that goes wrong ⇒ P2".
- The same defect with no workaround, on a non-core feature: neither the p1 nor the p2 row fits, so p3 by default, then rule 7, so p2. The defect that has a workaround now outranks the one that has none.
- A p1-row card on the default configuration: only 「升档永不至 p0」 stands between rule 7 and p0, and that sentence sits inside the focus rule.

With the p1 budget declined and one re-grade pass now licensed by the north star, this is the text that pass would run on.
Fix: say where the rule-7 raise lands, as `main` did. The p3 row held the clause in 118 bytes, so the fix is line-neutral and the ceiling row does not move. If triage holds that the ruling widened the raise to every row, that needs the ruling's words on the card, and the inversion above then needs an answer in the text.

**F2 — should-fix. Rule 3 says 「⛔ 无证据上限」 while the filing gate still puts an unmeasured finding at p3.**
Line 13 of this file, unchanged, admits a `finding` on one MEASURED wrong result at a public entry or on a named real producer. `triage-duties.md` (read, not in the diff) says 「缺 `reach:` 且非例外 ⇒ 定 `priority:p3`」 and folds the card into a sweep card. So a class-(b) finding read from code, mechanism stated, public door named but not exercised and no producer to name, is p3 by those two lines and its impact grade by rule 3. Two readings are tenable: `reach:` is the filing gate's admissibility test, from the 2026-09-21 ruling quoted at the head of the file, and rule 3 speaks only of findings past it; or rule 3 lifts it. The text at this head decides neither, and both the card's Acceptance and the PR body's sweep read as if the question did not exist.
Fix: triage, as the card's filer, says which reading holds, on the card. Then either the PR's Acceptance notes name these lines as swept and kept, or the lines are reconciled under an amended file surface. ⛔ Not by adding to rule 3 a condition the ruling does not carry.

Nits

- N1. Rule 7's 「带处方响亮拒绝不算」 compresses the card's "is the product working, not a defect" to "does not count". The pointer to north-star rule 4 carries the rest.
- N2. `main` said 「上调一档」; rules 1 and 8 now say 「升档」 without the step. It reads as one step, and it goes away if F1's fix names landing grades.
- N3. Rule 2's trigger list keeps the card's punctuation and with it the card's ambiguity: whether "a rare configuration act" is its own trigger or the way the privileged actor triggers it. Carried over, not introduced.
- N4. Three-state ② 「补步骤并继承该项档」 sits two lines under rule 9's 「项档继承只适用真实产品断」. They agree as ② was written: a product-defect card whose item's steps miss its path inherits, and a steps-only card is rule 9's. One clause would make that unmistakable; it is not required.

Two rules grading one case differently, the full list tried

- Rules 1 and 7 against the p2 row and north-star rule 2: **yes** (F1).
- Rule 3 against `triage-duties.md`'s p3 for a finding without `reach:`: **undecided by the text** (F2).
- Rule 4 against `lanes/triage.md`'s fixed `security`+p1: no, different cards (③ a).
- Rule 9 against three-state ①②: no (N4).
- The no-inheritance rule against `dispatch-runbook.md` 「父卡 p0/p1 ⇒ 产品阻塞卡同笔升同级,沿链重复」: no. Product blockers still inherit; the ruling removes inheritance for process and tooling cards only.
- Silent data loss reachable only by the highest privilege: p1, one step down to p2; unrecoverable, no discount, p1. The north star and rule 2 agree.
- A loud MCP refusal with its remedy: no raise, sorts first within its row. Consistent.

#### `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`

The three ruled changes are each stated once and faithfully, in 〈Priority〉 rules 2 and 3, and nothing else on the page moves. No budget and no auto-close appear. No gate on this head objects to the changed wording (all concluded green), and the page has no second copy in the tree.

- N5. The road paragraph's surviving "wrong result is P2" (③ c). An accepted deviation at this head, forwarded to the maintainer.

Rule 3's hold reaching a P2 blocking tooling card is the ruling's own consequence, carried in ③ b, and is not graded against the diff.

#### `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (the `filing-gate.md` CEILINGS row)

- The raise equals the measured delta. `filing-gate.md` is 67 lines on `main` and 79 at this head; the file's diff is +16 −4: fourteen rule lines in, two folded lines out, two rows edited in place. The row moves 67 → 79, headroom 0. No other row moves and no cross-file-move declaration is touched.
- Fourteen lines is the floor for this wording: rules 1, 2 and 9 total 178, 232 and 226 bytes, two lines each; rule 8 totals 253, and two lines hold at most 240.
- The comment cites what the header asks for: letter B (record 6184799323), the ordering ruling by its words and by audit id 6846766675, and the delta +12. The PR body quotes the same ids and the same delta.
- **Is the card body plus audit 6846766675 an acceptable ruling of record? Yes, as cited; a bare comment id is not the only acceptable form here.**
  - The header's bar is "a raise quoting no ruling id stays RED". An id is quoted, and it is a comment id on the card.
  - "That ruling comment's id" assumes a ruling that landed as a comment. This one was given in session and then carded. `filing-gate.md`'s own rule for a rules card the maintainer orders is that the body quotes his words, so the body is the designated carrier.
  - Two landed rows of this same map take this form: "the card body … and amendment comment 6592303181", and "the main-red resume card …, maintainer verbatim".
  - Audit 6846766675 is the comment-form record on that card. It is written by the session the ruling was given in, and it names the ruling, the three files and "ruling recorded".
  - N6 (nit). The two sentences the row quotes live in the body, which has no comment id and can be edited; the audit quotes other fragments of the same exchange, and only 「…其他同意」 overlaps. A ruling-record comment on #32997 carrying the verbatim words and the nine rules, with its id quoted in the row and the PR body, would pin them.
  - This review cannot open the session message. The truth of the transcription is checked by the maintainer's own Tier H approval, which the north-star path already requires.
- F1's fix is line-neutral. If the fix head changes the count, the row follows the new measured delta and never runs ahead of it.

F1 and F2 each earn a delta review of their fix by this reviewer. The nits end with this round.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-434w9w`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibvXzthnUYrxzphgFgW`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ed888e80e61d7283b30e9abd4d43e2760a1a25d8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, docs/NORTH-STAR.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

### ① Derived judgments

Delta review, round 2, of the fix to the round-1 record (PR comment 6850144637, FAIL on the previous head). Read: the one commit between the two heads, the net diff against `main` at this head (3 files, +26 −6), the card's two new comments (the seat's question 6850155803 and the filer's answer 6850654783), the re-patched PR body and this head's check-runs. The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not read. Result: F1 closed, F2 closed, no must-fix, no should-fix, ten nits (six carried, four new).

What moved between the heads

1. One line of `filing-gate.md`: the p3 row regains 「;真实用户可撞 ⇒ p2」. **Right.** The row is now byte-identical to `main`'s, 118 bytes. It is the fix round 1 named, taken at the place round 1 named.
2. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` are byte-identical between the two heads. **Right**: nothing else was owed a change.
3. No rule's text besides that row moved; rules 1 to 9 are as round 1 read them. **Right** for F1 and F2. The filer's two wording asks, which this head does not take, are judged in ④ (N9, N10).

Carried from round 1, the text under them unmoved: judgments 1, 3 to 6 and 8 to 16 stand as right. Judgment 2 (the dropped clause, wrong) is reversed by item 1 above. Judgment 7 (rule 7 right as a test, its effect gone) now reads right in full, because the row carries the effect.

Public surface: none, as before.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged. `skip-changeset` matches: the same three paths, none in any package's shipped files, so nothing publishes. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold, line-leading in the PR body. No `!` in the title.

Gate verdicts, the check-runs on this head read 2026-11-13T11:16Z: 50 runs, all completed, 28 success, 22 skipped, none failed, none pending. Among the successes: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path)` on the push and again on the body edit, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Test Core` with its three planned shards. `Check Changeset` concluded skipped on this head: that is the job's own exemption for the `skip-changeset` label, not a missing verdict. The PR is a draft with auto-merge not armed.

### ③ Boundary flags

The PR's author is the fleet relay, so there is no off-relay login to name.

New inputs at this head

- **The seat's question 6850155803.** Two questions to the card's filer: rule 3 against `reach:`, and which card writes the `Blocked-by:` line for rule 9. **Both answered** by 6850654783.
- **The filer's answer 6850654783** (fleet relay, signed by the same triage session as the card body and its audit). It is a colleague's reading, not a maintainer ruling. Round 1 named the filer's word as what closes F2, and this is that word.
  - Question 1: reading (a). `reach:` stays the admission test and rule 3 grades findings past it. The p3 for a finding without `reach:` is the admission consequence, lifted by measuring once at the named door or by naming the producer, after which triage regrades on impact. **Answered.** It decides the case round 1 posed and is coherent with both maintainer quotes: one removed a grading cap, the other governs filing.
  - Question 2: the release card writes a line-leading `Blocked-by:` naming the assertion card, and the index derives the label; for 18.4.0 that card is #32908. **Answered.** The label stays derived, as `SKILL.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` require.
  - The answer also makes two asks of the PR that this head does not take and the PR body does not mention: a scope clause on rule 3, and rule 9 worded by its mechanism. **Judged in ④ (N9, N10): neither is owed for F1 or F2.**
- **The re-patched PR body.** Its Acceptance notes now name the two lines as swept and kept and cite 6850654783, and "What changes" describes the p3 row as it now stands. Its Verification block still reports local gates "at 35d2eaeb", which is true of where they ran; this head's verdicts are its check-runs in ②. One wording nit, N8.

Round-1 escalations, status at this head

- (a) `lanes/triage.md`'s fixed `security`+p1: answered in round 1. Nothing owed.
- (b) North-star rule 3's hold reaching a P2 blocking tooling card: escalated to the maintainer. No carrier is visible in the inputs yet, neither on the card thread nor in the 维护者速读. **Still owed by the seat, not by the diff.**
- (c) The road paragraph's "wrong result is P2": escalated, one line in the Tier H approval request. The PR body lists it under "Left for the seat"; the 维护者速读 does not carry it yet. **Owed with the approval ask.**
- Suggested, not required: a third line in the same ask saying that rule 3 is read as leaving the filing gate's `reach:` p3 in place. Reading (a) is triage's reading of two maintainer rulings, and that line lets him object.

### ④ Design judgment

#### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md`

**F1 — closed.** The landing grade is back where `main` had it. The round-1 cases, retried against this head:

- A user-visible defect with a workaround, on the default configuration: p2 row. Rule 7's raise lands at p2, where the card already is, so p2. This matches `main` and north-star rule 2.
- The same defect with no workaround, on a non-core feature: p3 by default, then 「真实用户可撞 ⇒ p2」, so p2. The inversion is gone.
- A p1-row card on the default configuration: the raise lands at p2, below it. No path to p0.
- A default-p3 card in the focus feature that a real user can hit and where the agent gets a wrong answer: rule 1 makes rules 7 and 8 exclusive, so p2 by either and not p1. That is the ruling's "not both".

**F2 — closed**, by the first of the two routes round 1 named. The filer's reading is on the card (6850654783, reading (a)), and the PR's Acceptance notes name `filing-gate.md`'s admission line and `triage-duties.md`'s p3 line as swept and kept, citing that id. The case round 1 posed now has one answer: p3 until the door is measured once or the producer is named, and its impact grade after. The file's text is unchanged, so that answer lives on the card and in the PR body and not in the file; see N9.

New nits

- N7. The p3 row's clause and rule 7 are tied by their shared phrase alone, as the row stood on `main`. A numbered cross-reference does not fit the row under the cap (118 bytes plus 11). Rule 1's "at most one raise" keeps a reader from counting the clause at the impact step and rule 7 again at the raise step. No action.
- N8. The PR body says "Triage ruled on the card (6850654783)". The comment is the filer's answer; a ruling is the maintainer's. The id is right. Prose only.
- N9. The filer asks for a clause on rule 3 so the next reader does not re-ask. Round 1's ⛔ was against the diff settling the reading by itself; with the reading now given by the filer, a clause worded as a pointer to the admission test would be faithful to (a), and it fits the line (92 of 120 bytes). It is still text the maintainer's quoted ruling does not contain, so if it is taken it belongs in the 维护者速读, where his Tier H approval covers it. Not owed. The seat's call.
- N10. Rule 9 keeps the card's "carries `pm:blocking`". That is true as an outcome once the release card writes the line, and silent on who writes it. The filer asks for the mechanism wording. Whether it fits lines 58 and 59 under the cap (118 and 108 bytes) without a further raise is for the seat to measure. Not owed. The seat's call.

For N9 and N10: taking either makes a new head on a governed file and earns one more delta review of that hunk by this reviewer. Taking neither should be said on the card in answer to 6850654783, as an accepted deviation or a follow-up, because the filer asked there.

Carried nits, text unmoved

- N1. Rule 7's 「带处方响亮拒绝不算」 compresses the card's "is the product working, not a defect".
- N2. 「升档」 without the step. Narrowed: the row now names rule 7's landing, so this is rule 8's raise only.
- N3. Rule 2's trigger list keeps the card's punctuation and the card's ambiguity.
- N4. Three-state ② beside rule 9's 「项档继承只适用真实产品断」: they agree as ② was written.

Two rules grading one case differently, at this head

- Rules 1 and 7 against the p2 row and north-star rule 2: **no longer** (F1).
- Rule 3 against the p3 for a finding without `reach:`: **decided by the filer's reading on the card** (F2); the file's text is as before.
- The other five pairs tried in round 1 are unchanged: none.

#### `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`

Byte-identical to the previous head. The round-1 judgment stands: the three ruled changes are each stated once and faithfully in 〈Priority〉 rules 2 and 3, and nothing else on the page moves.

- N5, carried. The road paragraph's surviving "wrong result is P2", forwarded to the maintainer (③ c).

#### `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (the `filing-gate.md` CEILINGS row)

Byte-identical to the previous head.

- `filing-gate.md` is 79 lines at this head against 67 on `main`. The file's net diff is now +15 −3: fourteen rule lines in, two folded lines out, one row edited in place. The delta is +12, the row is 79, headroom 0.
- The fix was line-neutral, as round 1 expected, so the row did not move and the comment's account (fourteen lines, two folded, +12) is still true.
- Every line of the section is within the 120-byte cap (longest 120).
